title: Chicken Tagine Kisse
description: A hearty German-inspired stew made with chicken, kissed spices, and algerian flavors.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add spice blends, chicken broth, and heavy cream. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
